title: poa fascicularis
intro: Poa fascicularis, commonly known as Blue Mountain Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Poa fascicularis may include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and supporting immune function. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
